verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own structured-extraction features. These are `extract_rules`, a stringified-JSON parameter for CSS/XPath-based extraction, and `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction. It also offers dedicated Amazon and Walmart APIs that return structured product results, so the core of the story is delivered by the product itself. missing for 10: an explicit statement or response example showing that the extracted output is returned as a JSON body, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the extraction output format.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON
